text: ["What is the relationship between host galaxy metallicity and the fraction of oxygen-rich AGB stars that contaminate a purely photometric color–magnitude selection?","How does the photometric color–magnitude selection criteria (e.g., color cuts, magnitude limits) affect the inclusion of oxygen-rich AGB stars across different metallicities?","What observational or modeling techniques can be used to quantify and correct for oxygen-rich AGB contamination as a function of host galaxy metallicity?"]
